semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Immutable balanced accounting fact; corrections use reversal or governed adjustment, not mutation.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: ERP ledgers treat posted accounting documents as auditable records with controlled reversal.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Posting, reversal, reopening periods or history changes require approval and reviewer gate.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Analytic/dimensional coordinate for reporting and allocation, separate from account code and branch.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Market ERPs separate account, organizational unit and analytic dimension for segment reporting.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: If cost center becomes mandatory, defaulted or backfilled, involve Control Plane and reviewer.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Balancing accounting views by dimension when reports need branch, center or segment balances.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: SAP-style splitting shows why dimensional balances must remain internally balanced.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Any splitting or dimensional rebalance change escalates to architect.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Governed mapping from domain behavior to account roles and concrete accounts.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Posting profiles and account determination are configuration, not hardcoded logic.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Changing account determination requires Control Plane policy and approval.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Ledger receives accounting intent from AR, AP, Inventory, Tax, POS and Production through contracts.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: ERP suites integrate subledgers with GL through explicit posting rules.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Cross-domain posting semantics route to architect and relevant domain experts.

northStar.bestVersion: A country-agnostic accounting authority that converts governed economic facts into balanced, immutable and explainable journals, dimensions, balances, periods, reversals and financial statements.
businessOutcomes: Provide one trustworthy accounting truth across all UBP domains.
Open countries through account maps, books, calendars and policies instead of country code.
Trace every balance to source fact, policy version and correction chain.
invariants: Every journal balances by currency and has at least two lines.
Posted history is immutable and correction uses reversal or governed adjustment.
Only postable accounts are accepted and concrete accounts come from effective Account Maps.
A confirmed economic fact is posted or has a durable idempotent retry obligation.
northStar.configurationBoundary: Charts, account maps, books, calendars, dimensions, posting behavior and reporting layouts are versioned configuration; Ledger code enforces universal double-entry invariants.

lessons.observedCapability: Lifecycle-managed localization for tax, invoicing and regulatory reporting.
lessons.lesson: The accounting core and localization lifecycle need explicit separation.
lessons.ubpDecision: Keep double-entry and journal integrity universal while Control Plane publishes country accounting resources.

lessons.observedCapability: Fiscal localization installs country charts, taxes and reports and becomes constrained after posting.
lessons.lesson: Localization selection affects durable accounting history and cannot be treated as a casual runtime toggle.
lessons.ubpDecision: Version and activate accounting country packs with effective dates, migration checks and immutable posting provenance.

gates.purpose: Validate the closed V11 contract and deterministic broker behavior.
Require active ownership, approvals, pinned revision, manifest digest and verified seeds.
Block country leakage, hardcoded accounting decisions and non-durable posting failures.

enforcement.readyWhen: The manifest is valid, its registry authority is active, seeds resolve against the pinned UBP revision, applicable policies pass and implementation claims include reproducible code evidence.
